name: Homrogd (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Homrogd: a green shield with a white cross and a trefoil, between ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed HOMROGD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
